reviewKind: AI read-only diagnosis of saved synthetic live-provider evidence and existing rendered sources
qualityVerdict: FAIL: insufficient field and payroll-row extraction quality for this Hebrew corpus
failureCountMeaning: 23 and 24 are failed oracle checks, not counts of independent defects. A single omitted pension section causes several failures; some row failures are source-label fidelity failures despite correct numeric columns.
verificationBoundary: Blocking observations are from saved Gate0 validation and V2.1 resolution. This extraction-only corpus runner did not attempt downstream DB analysis or report publication, so no new DB financial-refusal proof is claimed.
scope: Both sources have additional wage components and are explicitly outside the single-regular-base DEV engineering financial scenario. Their legal gap oracle is null.

attributionLimits: The saved raw_extraction is the adapter's mapped output, not a verbatim copy of the SDK structured JSON. Exact provider-versus-adapter attribution for every omitted field is therefore limited.
For observed raw amounts/labels and row semantics, v2-mapper directly preserves the source values. No new deterministic money-normalization defect is evidenced by these two checkpoints.

Missing valid values, reversed/shortened Hebrew labels, column shifts and semantic omissions are real extraction-quality failures. Some ROW_* checks conflate correct arithmetic columns with source-label fidelity, so their counts should not be presented as independent numerical defects.
The missing and contradictory fixtures intentionally cannot yield a successful financial result; the observed field errors are additional failures, not the intended negative-case outcome.

completionCriteria: Show the exact input bytes/render/text-order relationship and isolate provider omissions from deterministic mapping with offline replay before another paid call.
Retain independent literal oracles, all pension/deduction rows and uncertainty gates; do not coerce unknown rows or derive absent hours to pass.
Report each source separately, including scan simulation and contradictory observations; count fidelity checks separately from numerical defects.
Any future paid evaluation requires its own bounded authorization within the existing ledger; this review authorizes no additional calls or model change.
